verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say the agent downloads files, such as logging into vendor portals to download invoice PDFs. Run artifacts like recordings and screenshots are captured automatically, but the evidence never documents uploading files to sites or retrieving the downloaded files afterwards. missing for 10: documented file-upload capability, documented retrieval/storage of downloaded files as run outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration of download handling.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards

citations.quote: Skyvern opens a real browser and does the work you describe: logging in, filling forms, downloading files and pulling data.
Log into vendor portals, find invoices, download PDFs.
Skyvern logs into vendor portals, downloads invoices, extracts line-item data and feeds it into your AP system
Every run automatically captures what happened: recordings of the browser session, screenshots at each step, the AI's reasoning, and network traffic.
